title: Nimble Kenyan Lamb Kebabs
description: Spicy mustardy lamb kebabs with a low-carb yogurt finish, perfect for a quick Kenyan-inspired dinner.
instructions: Cut lamb shoulder into 1.5-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Whisk together Dijon mustard, red chili flakes, cumin, paprika, lemon juice, and 1 tbsp olive oil to create the mustard glaze.
Pour the glaze over the lamb cubes, stir to coat, and refrigerate for 60 minutes.
Thread marinated lamb onto soaked bamboo skewers alternating with diced onion.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat (about 400°F).
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes, until lamb is browned and cooked to 145°F internal temperature.
While grilling, whisk 1 tbsp Greek yogurt with a pinch of salt to make a quick sauce.
Remove kebabs, drizzle with yogurt sauce, and garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
